before.relationship: Cult object placed in the temple and later removed
before.rationale: Manasseh places the carved image of the grove in the house; Josiah later brings the grove out of the Lord's house, burns it at Kidron, and scatters its dust. The relation preserves the supplied grove term without replacing it with a modern object identification.

after.relationship: Cult object placed in the temple and later removed
after.rationale: Manasseh places the carved image of the grove in the house; Josiah later brings the grove out of the Lord's house, burns it in the Kidron torrent, reduces it to dust, and throws the dust into the grave of the sons of the people. The relation preserves the supplied grove term without replacing it with a modern object identification.

changes.reason: Preserve the explicit dust destination in the grave of the sons of the people, rather than broadening threw into scattered.
